detail: A1: 2 axis(es) removed (half_life, min_plays), 12,960 declared configurations collapse to 864 distinct ones (15x duplication); nothing added or widened
may_not: be written after a Week-2 fit has been run

degeneracy_evidence.measured_from: nfl.research.oas1.frame.build over the three governed blobs in WEEK2_FIT_CONFIG.inputs

half_life.detail: the preregistration declares neither a current-season scope nor an all-training scope. Under the current-season reading the axis is exactly degenerate at week 2; under the all-training reading it double-parameterises the prior weight that rho and kappa already carry, and would borrow B3's games_back formula without justification.
half_life.reinstatement: a further amendment declaring the SCOPE, written before any fit whose training set carries two or more current-season weeks.

min_plays.detail: the only declared statement is MIN_SAMPLE_RULES, a reporting rule. Reporting cannot move an inner-fold score, so all three values give an identical objective.

retained_as.meaning: every unit is reported, with n_plays_current_season and prior_weight_effective attached
